desc:
Nexus Duels is a medium fast paced FPS (First person shooter) which consists of DUELS or FFA (free for all) amongst more gamemodes!

🏃 UNIQUE MOVEMENT
Wall run, slide, slide-jump, double jump and grab ledges. 

🏆 1v1 · 2v2 · 3v3 · RANKED
Climb the ranks, fill the Ranked Pass, and swap your loadout between ranked rounds to counter your opponent.

✨ LARGE COLLECTION OF WEAPON SKINS AND COSMETICS
Open crates, roll rare MUTATIONS, then trade with other players.

🗡️ Rifles, SMGs, snipers, katanas, karambits, grenades. Build your own loadout.
👥 Party up with friends: one leader, one button
🎮 PC, mobile and controller
📅 Daily and weekly quests, battle pass, live events

 New content added often. Like 👍 and favourite ⭐ to follow along!
